Change: Map: approximate-area pins get a visible dot
Details: The 1 km circle is under a pixel on a map of the whole country, so these pins showed as specks. Each now also has a 24px round dot at any zoom.

Change: Staff console: every account and every business, each number explained
Details: Two new sections. Akun lists every account with its contact, verification and the businesses it owns. Bisnis lists every business as Tayang or Tidak tayang, with the reason when it is not public. The two link to each other. The numbers under "Direktori saat ini" on Ringkasan now say what they count and open the list behind them. A member can no longer ask for a copy of their data from Dasbor; asking for the account to be deleted stays.

Change: Home filters trimmed, GLP Perk renamed GLP Promo
Details: The home page loses the Dekat saya chip with its radius row, the Produk & jasa filter, and the line "Direktori lulusan AsiaWorks" above the headline (a signed-in member still gets the greeting). The label GLP Perk reads GLP Promo wherever a member sees it.

Change: Import script for the Expo form's answers
Details: Reads the Google Form CSV and makes one account per email and one listing per row, through the same calls the app makes. Prints the plan unless --write is given, and leaves an email that already has an account alone.

Change: Home: the business list opens first on phones, tab renamed "Daftar Bisnis"
Showcase video: a feature reel with real taps, music and sound
Details: - The video now walks through six member features (Cari Bisnis, Hubungkan, Partner Kerja Sama, Buka Peluang, Cek Acara, Koneksi) with the app's real screens and taps, 47 seconds. The staff console is out. It closes on direktori.asiaworks.id and "made by omnisyncmedia". - capture.mjs clicks through the app as the demo member and saves each screen and the spot of each tap. It sends a real Hubungkan request, an RSVP and accepts a request, so undo those after a run. - make-audio.mjs synthesises the music and two effects; `npm run render` runs it first.

Change: Showcase video (Remotion), demo batch numbers within the real ones
Details: - video/: a 39-second 16:9 showcase built with Remotion from real screenshots of the app. It has its own package.json, so the app's install and build are unchanged (tsconfig leaves the folder out). `npm run render` inside it writes out/aw-direktori.mp4. - seed: batch numbers stay at or under the latest real ones (LP 200, IA 204, IB 210). - screenshot.mjs: --hide=<selector> and --tz=<timezone>.

Change: Hubungkan for every signed-in member, Profil lulusan open to visitors
Details: Hubungkan no longer needs a verified graduate: any signed-in member can send a request to a business or answer a Peluang. Staff accounts still take no part. The owner sees who is asking and accepts or declines as before. The "Profil lulusan" popup now opens for everyone. It reads the new public view graduate_feed (full name, nickname, programs, batch numbers), which only holds verified graduates who have a live business or an open Peluang. The owner's name sat inside a paragraph together with its sheet, which is not valid HTML (a dialog inside a p); those three wrappers are divs now. Schema: connect() and the view graduate_feed. For a database that already exists, run supabase/upgrades/2026-10-03-c-open-hubungkan-public-profile.sql.

Change: Profil lulusan: tap an owner's name to see the person in a popup
Details: The owner's name on a business card, a Peluang card and the business page is now a button. It opens a sheet with the person's full name, nickname, programs and batch numbers, every live business of theirs, their open Peluang, and Hubungkan for the card the name was on. Only verified graduates and staff see the person; anyone else gets the usual "sign in" or "wait for verification" note. That is the rule the database already has for reading profiles, so nothing changes there. Sheet: a sheet opened from inside another one no longer closes both when it is closed (React passes a dialog's "close" up the tree).

Change: Auto Approve Promo, direct Hubungkan, bottom navigation for the staff console
Details: - A third demo switch, "Auto Approve Promo", on the Promo queue. - Hubungkan is between the two members: the owner accepts or declines, the "Minta dikenalkan AsiaWorks" option and the staff Perkenalan queue are gone, and staff can no longer read requests. - On phones the staff console moves between sections with the bottom bar: Ringkasan, Verifikasi, Moderasi, Acara and "Lainnya" for the rest. An existing database needs supabase/upgrades/2026-10-03-b-auto-approve-promo-direct-connections.sql.

Change: Make the map pin the obvious choice, "Kirim" buttons, Peta before Daftar
Details: - Lokasi with no location yet: one large "Taruh pin di peta" action; the "Tambah lokasi" button shows once there is a location; "Online saja" is introduced as the way out for a business without a place. - The submit buttons for a business and a Peluang say "Kirim". - On phones the home page opens on Peta, and Peta comes before Daftar.

Change: Lokasi: the pin on the map comes first, "Online saja" second
Details: A listing with no location yet shows "Taruh pin di peta" as the first option; saved locations are listed above the "Online saja" switch.

Change: Demo switches: Auto Approve Bisnis and Auto Approve Peluang
Details: Staff can switch either on in Moderasi. While on, a listing or a Peluang sent by a verified graduate goes live at once, and whatever was waiting is approved. The audit log records each one. Both start off. An existing database needs supabase/upgrades/2026-10-03-auto-approve-bisnis-peluang.sql.

Change: Remove "Cara kerja verifikasi" from the home call-to-action
Details: The button and the sheet it opened are gone; "Pasang bisnis" stands alone.

Change: Serve the directory at / instead of /direktori
Details: The app gets its own domain, direktori.asiaworks.id, so the home page moves to / and business pages to /bisnis/[id]. Old /direktori addresses redirect.

Change: Footer: the asiaworks.id footer, rebuilt
Details: Same blocks as the main site's footer: "Langkah berikutnya" call to action (schedule + contact on asiaworks.id; the main API only answers asiaworks.id, so no live next-batch card), brand with "works in progress", Instagram / Facebook / YouTube buttons, office address with Google Maps and WhatsApp, navigation (the directory's pages + the main site's menu), the giant outlined ASIAWORKS and the copyright bar with the refund policy and "Ke atas".

Change: Match the asiaworks.id look: palette, fonts, wordmark, favicon, footer
Details: - palette from the main site (COLORS in its App.jsx): ice page #f7f7f9, ink #14181f, mist, line, maroonSoft, gold; new brass (#c9a84c), maroon-bright and navy tokens; maroon was already the same - Montserrat for everything (was Inter), headlines 900 / 800, eyebrows tracked like the main site - the AsiaWorks wordmark in Cinzel: ASIA + oversized maroon W + ORKS over a gold rule with DIREKTORI as the plaque line (same numbers as <Wordmark>) - favicon = the main site's favicon.svg, theme-color #8b1a1a - dark footer with rounded top, white headings with a gold bar, as on asiaworks.id

Change: Link back to the main AsiaWorks site
Details: The directory now runs on its own subdomain (direktori.asiaworks.id), so visitors need a way back to asiaworks.id: a text link in the desktop header (phones use the footer), an "AsiaWorks" footer column (site, programmes, schedule, contact) and the name in the copyright line.

Change: Add the database migration to the repository
Details: supabase/migrations/20261001000000_init.sql is the whole current schema (tables, row level security, functions, storage rules) for a new Supabase project. It was kept out of the repository until now; the README's set-up steps point at it, so it belongs next to the code. The file holds no key or password. The contact encryption key is generated inside the database (Supabase Vault) when the migration runs.

Change: Inter on the 404 page, stricter graduate approval, search by IA and IB batch
Details: What an independent review of the Inter and program-choice changes confirmed: - The 404 page sits outside the (aw) layout and was the one page not set in Inter. The font now lives in app/(aw)/_lib/font.ts and both trees use it. - Staff could approve a member who was sent back and then saved their data half-filled. verify_graduate now refuses a profile with no program, or with LP and no batch number. - Search also finds an owner's IA and IB batch ("IA 12"), not only LP. - Sign-up form: a ticked program box has a hover state, and the phone-number hint no longer breaks inside a word on a phone. - Header: the staff button stays on one line on 360px phones. - scripts/check.mjs proves the points above (IA without a number at the moment of asking, the refused approval, search by batch). - supabase/upgrades/2026-10-02-programs.sql carries the database side for a project that was set up before 2 October. Checked on the local stack: rule check 25 steps, 0 failed; browser sweep 340 checks, 0 failed.
